task: Bayesian constraints on ultralight bosons from black hole superradiance

method_commitments.bayesian_framework: Full posterior distribution ingestion via exclusion fraction and log-likelihood
method_commitments.superradiance_physics: Scalar field, dominant l=m=1 mode with Detweiler (1980) growth rate
method_commitments.self_interaction: Bosenova condition based on Arvanitaki & Dubovsky (2011)

named_methods.superradiance: Penrose process for massive scalar fields around Kerr BHs
named_methods.gravitational_atom: Hydrogenic spectrum with fine-structure constant alpha = GM*mu/(hbar*c^3)
named_methods.bosenova: Self-interaction collapse when interaction energy exceeds gravitational binding

fallbacks.superradiance_rate: Used analytic l=m=1 approximation from Detweiler (1980)
fallbacks.multi_mode: Only l=m=1 considered; noted as limitation
fallbacks.binary_effects: Level mixing not included; noted as limitation
